theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_cp_shrinking
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn f {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ} ≤ 1 ∧ volume ({y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} \ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}) ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |f y| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |f y|
